description: Executable attack variants that exercise distinct source patterns within already-covered vulnerability families.

variants.name: cross_function_reentrancy
variants.rationale: The attacker re-enters a second state-changing function during an unguarded withdrawal callback.

variants.name: mutable_delegatecall_proxy
variants.rationale: A caller-controlled implementation address executes delegatecall against structured proxy storage.

variants.name: callback_flash_loan
variants.rationale: An unguarded flash-loan callback can re-enter the reserve-sensitive withdrawal path.

variants.name: batch_dos_loop
variants.rationale: A caller-triggered distribution loop scales with an attacker-inflatable recipient list.

variants.name: timestamp_claim_gate
variants.rationale: A claim gate uses block.timestamp as a timing-sensitive authorization condition.
